| Directory | Upstream | Revision |
|---|---|---|
| `launcher3/` | [platform/packages/apps/Launcher3](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/apps/Launcher3) @ `android-14.0.0_r75` | fb0952266e40939d6ef73604c1906c5317bee66c |
| `systemui/iconloaderlib`, `systemui/animationlib` | [platform/frameworks/libs/systemui](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/libs/systemui) @ `android-14.0.0_r75` | 206da9e7aaef30a5474c8e672a555853406ec474 |
| `plugin_core/` | [platform/frameworks/base](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base) `packages/SystemUI/plugin_core` @ `android-14.0.0_r75` | — |

Only what the standalone (non-Quickstep) launcher needs is copied: `src`, `src_plugins`,
`src_shortcuts_overrides`, `src_ui_overrides` (kept for reference), `res`, `protos`,
`aconfig`, the manifests and `tests/multivalentTests/shared`.

**Do not edit files here.** Everything Not a Thing changes lives outside this directory:

- `launcher3/src/config/java` – stand-ins for classes the platform build generates
  (aconfig `Flags`, `BuildConfig`, statsd constants). `Flags.java` comes from
  `tools/gen_launcher_flags.py`.
- `launcher3/src/overrides/java` – the derivative-owned copy of `src_ui_overrides`
  (AOSP's designated extension layer); `PluginManagerWrapper` connects the in-process
  Not a Thing widgets.
- `app/` – the Not a Thing design: resource overrides (theme, fonts, palette generated by
  `tools/gen_nothing_theme.py`), the first-screen glance and the dot-matrix widgets.

## Updating

1. Replace the directories above with a newer tag (shallow clone, copy the same subfolders).
2. Copy any changes of `src_ui_overrides` into `launcher3/src/overrides/java`, keeping
   `PluginManagerWrapper`'s in-process plugin loading.
3. `python3 tools/gen_launcher_flags.py && python3 tools/gen_nothing_theme.py`
4. Add any newly referenced platform-only classes to `launcher3/src/config/java`.
